title: Pilot 1 Bounded Inference
description: Pilot 1 may ask one external model to propose typed hypotheses only after the outer runner has accepted explicitly safe evidence. The model is not an authority for execution facts, tool use, memory use, or canonical state.
context: Pilot 1 may ask one external model to propose typed hypotheses only after the outer runner has accepted explicitly safe evidence. The model is not an authority for execution facts, tool use, memory use, or canonical state.

rules: The outer runner MUST reject any request whose scope is not `SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE` or `PUBLICATION_SAFE` before invoking the model.

rules.requirement: No accepted evidence means no model call
rules: When Pilot 0 returns `NO_DATA`, Pilot 1 MUST return without invoking external inference.

rules.requirement: A valid Pilot 1 run is bounded to one model inference
rules: A valid proposed run MUST contain exactly one model inference. Observed extra model inferences MUST fail closed.

rules.requirement: Pilot 1 performs no tool or memory operations
rules: Observed real tool calls or memory operations MUST fail closed. Workspace bookkeeping MUST remain distinguishable from real tool use.

rules.requirement: Runtime receipt authority remains outside model prose
rules: Model output MAY propose typed `FACT`, `INFERENCE`, `HYPOTHESIS`, and `UNKNOWN` items, but MUST NOT determine runtime receipt facts. The deterministic outer runner MUST construct execution counts and receipt fields from controlled execution/readback.

constraints: Model fluency or self-report MUST NOT upgrade a hypothesis into a runtime fact.
Private or unclassified evidence MUST NOT reach external inference in this phase.
Canonical memory/preferences MUST NOT be written by Pilot 1.
Runtime evidence, semantic proposal validity, and repository desired state remain separate claims.

scenarios.name: Unapproved scope is rejected before inference
given: an evidence packet whose requested scope is not SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE or PUBLICATION_SAFE
then: AND the inference callback is not invoked

scenarios.requirement: No accepted evidence means no model call
scenarios.name: Pilot 0 reports NO_DATA
then: AND external model calls equal zero

scenarios.requirement: A valid Pilot 1 run is bounded to one model inference
scenarios.name: Trace reports more than one inference
when: runtime trace evidence reports more than one model inference
then: Pilot 1 rejects the run as a policy violation

scenarios.requirement: Pilot 1 performs no tool or memory operations
scenarios.name: Runtime trace reports a tool or memory operation
when: runtime trace evidence reports a real tool call or memory operation
then: Pilot 1 rejects the run as a policy violation

scenarios.requirement: Runtime receipt authority remains outside model prose
scenarios.name: Model prose lies about runtime counts
given: model output that claims an incorrect external model call count
when: the outer runner constructs the receipt
then: the receipt reflects the actual controlled invocation/readback
AND the model-authored count does not control receipt fields
